incident_summary: Container door seal failed during a Force 8 squall in Malacca Strait. Saltwater ingress wet the back-bottom section of the container before the seal was re-secured at the next port of call. Wet stains and salt deposits are visible on the back wall and lower side panels. Survey conducted by Lloyd's-appointed surveyor Mr. Karthikeyan on 2026-04-15 at Singapore (transhipment) and re-surveyed at Hamburg 2026-05-08 by Hanseatic Marine Survey.
_doc: carton_damage_pct: 0.0 = dry, 0.30 = roughly 30% of carton contents water-damaged (typically surface salt staining, some inner-product moisture exposure; commodity-dependent salvage value), 1.00 = full water damage (carton soaked through, contents unsalvageable).
